title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar | TechCrunch
summary: First introduced at Meta’s Connect developer conference in September, the video-chatting feature involves new AI models, Muse Realtime Avatar and Muse Realtime Voice technology, which help power the digital avatar that chats with the user.
